sloka: द्रोण मात्र प्रमाणानि लम्बमानानि वानराः ।ययुः पिबन्तो हृष्टास् ते मधूनि मधु पिन्गलाः ॥६-४-९१॥।।
transliteration: droṇa mātra pramāṇāni lambamānāni vānarāḥ ।yayuḥ pibanto hṛṣṭās te madhūni madhu pingalāḥ ॥6-4-91॥।।

translations.english: The tawnyeyed monkeys went joyfully drinking the honey from the large honeycombs hanging there.
